affordance_manifest.success: ≥1 item → one line per item, 1-based, `N) [ ] <text>` / `N) [x] <text>`, in store order, exit 0
affordance_manifest.error: corrupted store → corrupted-store message to stderr, exit 1; never writes to the store under any input
affordance_manifest.empty: 0 items (missing file OR `[]` on disk) → `No todos yet.` to stdout, exit 0 — never an error
